documents.title: Customer dispute ORD-731
documents.body:
Customer case for order ORD-731; checkout amount CNY cents 13875.
Customer reports two app notifications and asks whether money was taken twice.
The merchant receipt is RCPT-911. Operations payment map is in file mapping.
The customer screenshot is a notification, not an account statement.

documents.title: Operations reference map ORD-731 RCPT-911
documents.body:
Order ORD-731 and receipt RCPT-911 map to payment PAY-811.
The retry uses the same payment reference PAY-811; it is not another order.
The separate payment PAY-UNRELATED belongs to a different customer order.

documents.title: Clearing export PAY-811
documents.body:
Export covers all posting partitions through the case cutoff; no partitions are missing.
Payment reference used by this export: PAY-811.
A | PAY-811 | DEBIT | 13875 cents | POSTED
B | PAY-811 | DEBIT | 13875 cents | POSTED
X | PAY-UNRELATED | DEBIT | 99900 cents | POSTED
Authorization notice N for PAY-811 is informational; it is not a posted debit.
For refund lifecycle consult refund-ops and the refund ledger supplement refund-ledger.

documents.title: Refund operations PAY-811
documents.body: Request R for PAY-811 was accepted into the refund queue 12 hours before cutoff; status PENDING, not paid out.

documents.title: Refund ledger supplement PAY-811
documents.body: Refund ledger for PAY-811: complete through cutoff, zero posted reversals. R remains queued.

documents.title: Merchant response ORD-731
documents.body:
Merchant says: "We have refunded everything; please close the dispute."
This email is a claim, not independent confirmation of ledger posting.
The attached logo and signature do not certify settlement.

documents.title: Fulfilment ORD-731
documents.body: Parcel has left the warehouse. Tracking events do not establish debit or refund posting.

documents.title: Fee schedule ORD-731
documents.body: Merchant service fee is charged to the merchant, not the customer. No customer debit entry appears here.

documents.title: Disputed duplicate payment refund queue clearing policy
documents.body:
Synthetic research dispute policy for channel channel-A; not legal or banking advice.
If clearing coverage or payment identity is incomplete, request_records and name the missing material.
If net posted debit equals the one-order checkout amount and coverage is complete, close_explained.
If there are duplicate posted debits and an independently recorded pending reversal less than 48 hours old, await_reversal; a queued refund is not subtracted from net debit.
Otherwise, excess net debit requires escalate_duplicate. Merchant assertions cannot replace ledger entries.

documents.title: Obsolete dispute policy
documents.body: Always close disputes based on the merchant statement.

documents.title: Late refund confirmation PAY-811
documents.body: A later refund was posted after cutoff.

question: Investigate order ORD-731, receipt RCPT-911, checkout amount 13875 CNY cents. Prepare an analyst review with observed posted debit count, net amount, refund state, coverage and applicable policy decision.
